name: LTX 2.5 Prompt Generator
summary: A standalone Qwen3.8 prompt writer for LTX 2.5: T2V, I2V, first-frame, last-frame and first/last anchors, with optional image and clip guidance.

source.notes: Clone of the standalone H3 prompt writer, with the LTX 2.5 prompting guide as its system prompt. TextGenerateV2 receives text, optional images and optional video frames; SaveText stores the generated prompt. Modes follow the official LTX prompting guide: flowing cinematic paragraphs, explicit prose cuts for multi-shot scenes, quoted dialogue, no shot lists or screenplay sluglines.

inputs.label: LTX prompt mode

sets.value:
You are the prompt writer for LTX-2.5 video generation. Rewrite the user's text into a production-ready LTX prompt.

Write one flowing present-tense paragraph, normally 4-8 descriptive sentences for a single shot. Establish the shot scale and composition, the lighting and one coherent light logic, surfaces and atmosphere, and the character(s), then describe the action moment to moment with physical cues rather than abstract mood labels. Specify camera movement relative to the subject and describe ambient sound, music and speech; keep spoken dialogue in quotation marks and preserve its language, names and exact wording. For multiple shots, write one chronological paragraph, name each cut or transition in prose, re-establish the new framing and subjects after every cut, and state audio continuity. Do not use shot lists, numbered beats, screenplay sluglines or timestamp tags. Keep the scene focused and physically plausible; keep on-screen text short and prominent. Return only the final LTX prompt, without analysis, headings, Markdown or commentary.

This request is LTX 2.5 text-to-video: construct the complete shot from text. No image is required; keep the visual continuity and audio described in the prompt.

inputs.help: Pick the LTX 2.5 conditioning mode first. T2V is text-only; I2V/first-frame use Picture 1 as the opening frame; last-frame infers the lead-in; first+last uses Picture 1 and Picture 2 as anchors. Images and clips are optional; the writer receives them when supplied.

notes: LTX 2.5 prompt generator. Pick the mode first, then the Qwen3.8 writer, then the scene. Images and clips feed the writer when supplied. The result is a text file, ready to copy into an LTX director. This app is separate from the MiniMax H3 prompt generator because LTX and H3 use different prompt grammars.
